$comment: Final score is a weighted blend of three independent columns, each normalised to 0-100.
If no human score has been entered, the report shows an AUTO score with the human
weight redistributed proportionally, and flags the row as un-reviewed.
gateWeights: relative weight of each Playwright check inside the technical column.
Only checks listed in a benchmark's `checks` array are counted, and the
weights are renormalised over those — so omitting `fps` on a static page
does not cost the model anything.
judgeAxes:   what every judge in the quorum scores, 0-10 each.

judgeAxes.label: Craft & polish
judgeAxes.description: Visual quality, typography, colour, composition, motion feel, finish. Would a discerning person believe a human designed this on purpose?

judgeAxes.label: Technical ambition
judgeAxes.description: How hard is what was actually built, and is it built correctly? Real technique versus the cheapest thing that looks similar.

judgeAxes.label: Brief adherence
judgeAxes.description: Did it do everything the prompt asked, completely, including the output contract? Stubs and TODOs count against.

judgeAxes.label: Originality
judgeAxes.description: Is the idea and its execution distinctive, or is it the median AI answer to this prompt?
